analysis:
Integration pass over the desktop GUI self-update channel, which is new supply-chain surface. No concrete regression is established from the supplied evidence.

Replayed source shows:
- .github/workflows/release-desktop.yml embeds a fixed generic https feed (FEED_URL, line ~35, passed as DARKBLOOM_DESKTOP_UPDATE_URL at ~129).
- desktop-app/electron-builder.ts (~30-31) refuses a release build without a feed. The tests also cover rejecting an http feed.
- The DMG is restamped after signing and stapling (workflow ~160).
- The verify step greps app-update.yml for the feed URL and runs update-feed.mjs `check`, which compares every entry's sha512 and size against the files.
- The publish step uploads the zip, blockmap and DMG first and latest-mac.yml last, with --clobber, to a mutable prerelease (workflow ~230-246).

update-feed.mjs parses build-generated YAML with regexes and takes no untrusted input.

Trust anchors are GitHub release write access on desktop-v* tags and the Developer ID signature that the updater (Squirrel.Mac/electron-updater) must validate. The sha512 in latest-mac.yml is integrity only, not authenticity, because it is hosted alongside the zip. The updater runtime code (src/main/updates.ts, updateFeed.ts) is not in the supplied evidence, so the following remain unverified contracts: signature enforcement, no-downgrade behavior, and https enforcement in the main process. Several units were omitted from replay (21 of 55).

A compromised or mis-scoped publisher could push a malicious GUI to all installs. That GUI drives local provider operations. The retained threat model has no entry for the desktop update channel; it is adjacent to T-013 and T-034 and merits a threat-model note.

Availability only: non-atomic --clobber uploads can briefly leave the feed inconsistent with the zip, in which case the updater fails on sha512 and retries. The docs-only units (desktop-app.md and desktop-release.md) change no controls. The provider wire protocol, attestation, App Attest (A-016, A-017, TB-009, TB-011) and the cache (T-041) are untouched.
